items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...compared to -- well, compared to the Wayne Kings and the Guy Lombardos, and people like that. Right? [INTERVIEWEE] Right.

ctx.x: Yes, I guess that's it, isn't it. Well, maybe it's that the whole thing is that it's always pretty well been here that what's making the dollar is what people are going to talk about. And, I mean, jazz wasn't something that was considered a real money maker. Not compared to -- well, compared to the Wayne Kings and the Guy Lombardos, and people like that. Right?
